dishes.name: Bibimbap
dishes.veganApproach: The seasoned beef is replaced with pan-fried or marinated tofu and the egg is omitted (or kept for the vegetarian version).
dishes.technique: Each vegetable is blanched or sautéed and seasoned separately as namul, then arranged over warm rice with gochujang and mixed together at the table.

dishes.name: Kimchi jjigae
dishes.veganApproach: Uses vegan kimchi (standard kimchi contains fish sauce or salted shrimp), a kelp-shiitake broth instead of anchovy stock, and tofu or mushrooms instead of pork.
dishes.technique: Well-fermented sour kimchi is sautéed with aromatics, then simmered in stock with chili paste and tofu until the broth is deeply savory.

sources.title: Vegan Kimchi Jjigae - The Korean Vegan

dishes.name: Sundubu jjigae
dishes.veganApproach: A chili oil base is built with mushrooms and vegetable or kelp broth, the meat and egg are left out, and silky soft tofu becomes the whole protein.
dishes.technique: Gochugaru is bloomed in oil with garlic to make a spicy base, then stock and spoonfuls of silken tofu are added and boiled hard in an earthenware pot; an egg is cracked in at the end.

sources.title: Sundubu jjigae (Spicy soft tofu stew) - Maangchi
Haemul sundubu jjigae (Seafood soft tofu stew) - Maangchi
Sundubu Jjigae (Vegan Recipe) - The Foodie Takes Flight

dishes.name: Doenjang jjigae
dishes.veganApproach: The anchovy stock is replaced with a kelp and dried shiitake broth, which keeps the deep umami of the fermented soybean paste.
dishes.technique: Doenjang is dissolved in stock and simmered with diced potato, zucchini, onion and tofu until the vegetables are tender and the broth is rich and earthy.

sources.title: Doenjang jjigae (Fermented soybean paste stew) - Maangchi
Vegan Doenjang Jjigae (Korean Soybean Paste Stew) - Veggie Anh

dishes.name: Japchae
dishes.veganApproach: The beef is left out and shiitake mushrooms carry the savory flavor, with the egg garnish skipped for vegan or kept for vegetarian.
dishes.technique: Each vegetable is stir-fried separately to keep its color, then tossed with the boiled glass noodles in a sweet soy and sesame oil seasoning.

dishes.name: Tteokbokki
dishes.veganApproach: Fish cakes and anchovy stock are replaced with kelp broth and cabbage or tofu puffs; boiled eggs can stay for the vegetarian version.
dishes.technique: Chewy rice cakes are simmered in a sweet-spicy gochujang broth until the sauce reduces to a thick, glossy coating.

sources.title: Tteokbokki (Hot and spicy rice cakes) - Maangchi

dishes.name: Kimchi bokkeumbap
dishes.veganApproach: Made with vegan kimchi and no meat, optionally with tofu or mushrooms; the fried egg on top is kept only for the vegetarian version.
dishes.technique: Sour kimchi is fried in oil until caramelized, then day-old rice is added and tossed over high heat with kimchi juice and sesame oil.

sources.title: Vegan Kimchi Fried Rice - The Korean Vegan
Kimchi Fried Rice 101 - My Eclectic Bites

dishes.name: Bulgogi
dishes.veganApproach: King oyster or shiitake mushrooms are sliced thin and soaked in the same pear, soy and garlic marinade, then seared in a hot skillet.
dishes.technique: Thin slices are marinated in a sweet pear-soy marinade and cooked fast over high heat on a grill or skillet, then wrapped in lettuce with rice and ssamjang.

dishes.name: Gimbap
dishes.veganApproach: The beef and egg strips are replaced with soy-braised or pan-fried tofu, as in Buddhist temple-style gimbap.
dishes.technique: Sesame-seasoned rice is spread thinly on seaweed, lined with colorful seasoned fillings, rolled tightly with a bamboo mat and sliced into rounds.

sources.title: Tofu Gimbap (Vegan Temple Gimbap) - Korean Bapsang

dishes.name: Pajeon
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when the batter is made with just flour, water and a little soybean paste; vegetarian versions add egg to the batter.
dishes.technique: Long green onions are laid side by side in a hot oiled skillet, covered with a thin batter and pressed and flipped until crisp and golden on both sides.

sources.title: Korean Scallion Pancakes (Pajeon) - The Foodie Takes Flight

dishes.name: Haemul pajeon
dishes.technique: Battered green onions are laid in the pan, topped with chopped seafood and a drizzle of beaten egg, then fried in generous oil until crisp on both sides.

sources.title: Haemul Pajeon (Seafood Scallion Pancake) - Korean Bapsang

dishes.name: Kimchijeon
dishes.veganApproach: The batter is already egg-free, so using vegan kimchi (no fish sauce or salted shrimp) makes the pancake fully vegan.
dishes.technique: Chopped sour kimchi and its brine are mixed into a loose flour batter and fried thin in plenty of oil until the edges are lacy and crisp.

sources.title: Easy Crispy Korean Kimchi Pancakes - The Korean Vegan

dishes.name: Yangnyeom chicken
dishes.nameEn: Korean fried chicken in sweet-spicy glaze (vegan tofu version)
dishes.veganApproach: Pressed tofu (or cauliflower) is coated in a starchy batter, double-fried and tossed in the same sticky gochujang-garlic glaze.
dishes.technique: Pieces are coated in a thin starch batter and double-fried for a shatteringly crisp crust, then tossed in a sweet, spicy and garlicky sauce.

sources.title: Vegan Korean Fried Chicken - Cheap Lazy Vegan
Tofu Korean Fried Chicken - Blonde Kimchi

dishes.name: Mandu
dishes.veganApproach: The pork is replaced with extra crumbled tofu, mushrooms and glass noodles, often with chopped vegan kimchi for kimchi mandu.
dishes.technique: A drained, well-seasoned filling of tofu, noodles and vegetables is folded into thin wrappers, then steamed, pan-fried or dropped into soup.

sources.title: Homemade Vegan Dumplings (Kimchi Mandu) - The Korean Vegan

dishes.name: Jjajangmyeon
dishes.veganApproach: Pork belly is swapped for mushrooms or tofu cubes, and the black bean sauce itself stays the same.
dishes.technique: Black bean paste is fried in oil to remove its bitterness, then simmered with diced vegetables and thickened with starch into a glossy sauce over chewy noodles.

sources.title: Jjajangmyeon (Korean Black Bean Noodles) - The Korean Vegan

dishes.name: Budae jjigae
dishes.veganApproach: Spam and sausage are replaced with plant-based sausages and tofu, the cheese is skipped or made vegan, and vegan kimchi and egg-free ramen are used.
dishes.technique: Everything is arranged raw in a shallow pot, topped with a spicy seasoning paste and stock, then boiled at the table until the noodles soften.

sources.title: Vegan Budae Jjigae - Cheap Lazy Vegan

dishes.name: Mul-naengmyeon
dishes.nameEn: Cold buckwheat noodles in chilled broth
dishes.veganApproach: The beef broth is replaced with a chilled broth of kelp, shiitake and radish water kimchi brine, without the beef slices; the egg can stay for vegetarian.
dishes.technique: Chewy buckwheat noodles are boiled briefly, shocked in ice water and served in a slushy, tangy broth with pear, cucumber and mustard.

sources.title: Mul-naengmyeon (Korean cold noodles in chilled broth) - Maangchi
Mul Naengmyeon (Korean Cold Noodle Soup) Vegan - Gastroplant

dishes.name: Jjamppong
dishes.technique: Vegetables and seafood are flash-fried in wok oil with chili flakes to make a smoky, fiery broth, which is poured over thick wheat noodles.

sources.title: Korean Spicy Seafood Noodle Soup (Jjamppong) - My Korean Kitchen

dishes.name: Bibim guksu
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the boiled egg and use vegan kimchi (or none); the sweet-sour gochujang dressing is already plant-based.
dishes.technique: Thin wheat noodles are boiled, rinsed ice-cold and tossed with a sweet, sour and spicy gochujang dressing, then topped with crunchy vegetables.

sources.title: Bibim Guksu (Korean Spicy Cold Noodles) - Korean Bapsang

dishes.name: Kalguksu
dishes.veganApproach: The clams and anchovy stock are replaced with a kelp and shiitake broth, with extra zucchini and potato.
dishes.technique: A simple wheat dough is rolled and cut into thick noodles that cook directly in the broth, so their starch gives the soup a silky body.

sources.title: Kalguksu (Korean Noodle Soup with Clams) - My Korean Kitchen

dishes.name: Dubu jorim
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: pan-fried tofu braised in a soy, chili and garlic sauce.
dishes.technique: Slabs of tofu are pan-fried until golden, then simmered in a soy-chili sauce until it reduces to a sticky glaze.

sources.title: Dubu Jorim (Korean Braised Tofu) - Korean Bapsang

dishes.name: Tteokguk
aliases: korean new year rice cake soup
dishes.veganApproach: The beef broth is replaced with a kelp, shiitake and radish broth; the egg garnish is dropped for vegan or kept for vegetarian.
dishes.technique: Oval rice cake slices simmer in a clear, savory broth until soft and floating, then are garnished with egg ribbons and crushed seaweed.

dishes.name: Gamjajeon
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan: grated potato and its own starch bind the pancake with no egg or flour needed.
dishes.technique: Potatoes are finely grated, the liquid is drained and the settled starch is mixed back in, then the batter is fried thin until crisp and chewy.

dishes.name: Yachaejeon
dishes.veganApproach: The egg is left out of the batter and a little potato or rice starch is added for crispness.
dishes.technique: Julienned vegetables are bound with just enough batter to hold together and pan-fried into thin, crisp pancakes served with soy-vinegar dip.

sources.title: Korean Vegetable Pancake (Yachae Jeon) - The Foodie Takes Flight

dishes.name: Ojingeo bokkeum
dishes.technique: Scored squid and vegetables are stir-fried quickly over high heat in a spicy gochujang sauce so the squid stays tender, then served over rice.

sources.title: Ojingeo Bokkeum (Korean Spicy Stir-fried Squid) - Korean Bapsang

dishes.name: Dubu kimchi
dishes.veganApproach: The pork is left out (or replaced with mushrooms) and vegan kimchi is stir-fried and served with warm blanched tofu.
dishes.technique: Sour kimchi is stir-fried with onion and a little sugar until caramelized, then served next to slices of warm blanched or pan-fried tofu.

sources.title: Dubu Kimchi (Tofu with Stir-fried Kimchi) - Korean Bapsang

dishes.name: Rabokki
dishes.nameEn: Spicy rice cakes with ramen noodles
dishes.veganApproach: Fish cakes and anchovy stock are skipped in favor of kelp broth and cabbage, using egg-free ramen; boiled eggs stay for vegetarian.
dishes.technique: Rice cakes simmer in a sweet-spicy gochujang broth and instant ramen is added at the end to soak up the sauce.

dishes.name: Jeyuk bokkeum
dishes.veganApproach: Torn oyster or king oyster mushrooms replace the pork and are stir-fried in the same fiery gochujang marinade.
dishes.technique: Thin slices are coated in a garlicky gochujang marinade and stir-fried over high heat with onion until charred at the edges, then eaten with rice and lettuce.

sources.title: Korean Spicy Pork Stir-Fry (Vegan) - The Foodie Takes Flight
Vegan Jeyuk Bokkeum (Spicy Korean Stir-Fried Mushrooms) - The Vegan Planet Kitchen

dishes.name: Miyeokguk
dishes.veganApproach: The beef is replaced with shiitake or other mushrooms sautéed in sesame oil, with a kelp-based broth.
dishes.technique: Rehydrated seaweed is sautéed in sesame oil with garlic, then simmered for a long time until the broth turns milky and deeply savory.

sources.title: Vegan Korean Seaweed Soup - Cheap Lazy Vegan
Korean Seaweed Soup (Miyeok Guk) - Kreamy Vegan

dishes.name: Kongguksu
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally plant-based apart from the optional boiled egg garnish, which is simply omitted.
dishes.technique: Soaked soybeans are briefly boiled and blended with sesame and pine nuts into a thick, nutty chilled soy milk, poured over cold thin noodles.

sources.title: Easy and Delicious Cold Kong Guksu - The Korean Vegan

dishes.name: Bindaetteok
dishes.veganApproach: The pork is replaced with mushrooms or simply omitted, and vegan kimchi is used; the ground mung bean batter needs no egg or flour.
dishes.technique: Soaked mung beans are ground into a thick batter, mixed with kimchi and vegetables, and shallow-fried in plenty of oil until crunchy outside.

dishes.name: Janchi guksu
dishes.veganApproach: The anchovy stock is replaced with a kelp and shiitake broth and the egg garnish is skipped (or kept for vegetarian).
dishes.technique: Thin wheat noodles are cooked separately, rinsed and served in a light clear broth topped with sautéed zucchini, carrot, egg ribbons and seaweed.

dishes.name: Sujebi
dishes.veganApproach: A kelp and shiitake broth replaces the anchovy stock, as in Buddhist temple versions with potato and courgette.
dishes.technique: A rested flour dough is stretched paper-thin with wet fingers and torn straight into a simmering potato broth.

dishes.name: Yukgaejang
dishes.nameEn: Spicy shredded beef soup (vegan mushroom version)
dishes.veganApproach: Shredded oyster or king oyster mushrooms replace the brisket in a kelp and shiitake broth seasoned with chili oil.
dishes.technique: Shredded protein, fernbrake and lots of green onion are seasoned with chili flakes and sesame oil, then simmered into a fiery red soup.

sources.title: Vegan Yukgaejang with Mushroom - My Eclectic Bites

dishes.name: Hoe-deopbap
dishes.technique: Cubes of fresh raw fish are piled on rice with crisp shredded greens and mixed with a sweet-sour vinegared gochujang sauce.

dishes.name: Jjolmyeon
dishes.veganApproach: Simply omit the hard-boiled egg; the noodles and the sweet-sour gochujang sauce are plant-based.
dishes.technique: Very chewy wheat-starch noodles are boiled, rinsed icy cold and mixed with crunchy vegetables in a tangy, spicy gochujang dressing.

dishes.name: Godeungeo jorim
dishes.technique: Mackerel pieces are laid over thick slices of radish and braised in a spicy soy-chili sauce until the radish is soft and saturated with the fish juices.

dishes.name: Sanchae bibimbap
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan in its temple form, built entirely on foraged mountain greens; some restaurants add an egg (vegetarian).
dishes.technique: Rehydrated wild mountain greens are each simmered and sautéed with soup soy sauce and sesame oil, then arranged over rice and mixed with chili or soybean paste.

sources.title: A Korean feast that honours Buddha's birth - BBC Travel

dishes.name: Yeonnipbap
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan Buddhist temple dish of rice, nuts and grains.
dishes.technique: Glutinous rice mixed with chestnuts, jujubes, beans and nuts is wrapped in a lotus leaf and steamed so it takes on the leaf's fragrance.

sources.title: Lotus leaf dish contains the power of prayer - Korea JoongAng Daily

dishes.name: Kongbiji jjigae
dishes.veganApproach: The pork and salted shrimp are left out, mushrooms add depth, and vegan kimchi is used with ground soybeans or okara.
dishes.technique: Soaked soybeans are ground into a coarse purée and simmered with sautéed kimchi until it forms a creamy, curd-like stew.

sources.title: Kongbiji Jjigae (Ground Soybean Stew) - Korean Bapsang
Kongbiji Jjigae (Okara Stew) - Earth to Veg

dishes.name: Beoseot jeongol
dishes.veganApproach: The beef is left out and a kelp-shiitake broth is used, letting the many kinds of mushrooms and tofu carry the hot pot.
dishes.technique: Mushrooms, vegetables and tofu are arranged in neat sections in a wide shallow pot, then covered with seasoned broth and simmered at the table.

sources.title: Beoseot Jeongol (Mushroom Hot Pot) - Korean Bapsang

dishes.name: Kongnamul gukbap
dishes.veganApproach: A kelp and shiitake stock replaces the anchovies, salted shrimp is replaced with salt or soup soy sauce, and the egg is omitted (or kept for vegetarian).
dishes.technique: Soybean sprouts are boiled in stock with the lid closed to avoid a raw smell, then the clear, refreshing soup is poured over rice in a hot earthenware bowl.

sources.title: Kongnamul-gukbap (Soybean sprout soup with rice) - Maangchi

dishes.name: Gungjung tteokbokki
dishes.veganApproach: The beef is replaced with extra shiitake mushrooms in the same sweet soy and sesame sauce.
dishes.technique: Rice cakes are blanched and stir-fried with julienned vegetables and mushrooms in a mild, sweet soy glaze, the royal court's non-spicy original.

sources.title: Gungjung Tteokbokki (Korean Royal Court Rice Cakes) - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Makguksu
dishes.veganApproach: Served with a chilled radish water kimchi and kelp broth instead of beef broth, and without the boiled egg for vegan.
dishes.technique: Rustic buckwheat noodles are boiled, chilled and served with a spicy seasoning and a splash of cold tangy broth poured in at the table.

dishes.name: Galchi jorim
dishes.technique: Pieces of silvery hairtail are braised on a bed of radish and potato in a spicy soy-chili sauce until the sauce thickens.

dishes.name: Maeuntang
dishes.technique: A whole cut-up fish, including the head and bones, is simmered with radish in a chili-spiked broth, then finished with fresh greens.

dishes.name: Agujjim
dishes.technique: Monkfish is steamed over a mound of soybean sprouts, then tossed in a fiery chili sauce thickened with starch.

dishes.name: Jeonbokjuk
dishes.technique: Soaked rice and sliced abalone are sautéed in sesame oil with the abalone innards, then slowly simmered and stirred into a creamy, savory porridge.
